definitions.explanation: The remains or site of a former castle. Japan has hundreds of castle ruins, many of which are popular tourist destinations and historical landmarks.

examples.japanese: {城跡|しろあと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{城跡|しろあと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This castle site is also known as a famous spot for cherry blossoms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{石垣|いしがき}→石垣：19673_ishigaki⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧{城跡|しろあと}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一望|いちぼう}→一望：19625_ichibou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: From the castle ruins where only the stone walls remain, you can see the whole town.

notes:
USAGE:
{城跡|しろあと} refers to the site where a castle once stood, including any remaining structures like stone walls or moats. Many Japanese {城跡|しろあと} are designated as historical sites.

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as じょうせき in more formal or academic contexts, but ⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧あと is the standard everyday reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {城跡|しろあと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねる→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧: to visit castle ruins
- {城跡|しろあと}⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧: castle ruins park
- {城跡|しろあと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石垣|いしがき}→石垣：19673_ishigaki⟧: stone walls of castle ruins

FORMS:
⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧ (castle) + ⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧ (remains, trace).
